During my internship at Moses, Inc. I had the privilege of working on a wide variety of project types, for many different clients, under the collective experience and leadership of many individuals.

Please note that I was a part of each project listed below, and I make no claim to sole responsibility for any work I touched during my time with the agency.

  • DinnerLab
  • Phoenix 10K & Half Marathon
  • AZ Pinnacle Law
  • GAEMS
  • Eggcyte
  • ADHS – Nutrition Network
  • ADHS – HIVAZ.org
Steve Clawson, senior PR manager at Moses, Inc. “I had the opportunity to work with Jérémy during his time at Moses Inc. He impressed me right from the start. He had only been at Moses for a short time when he was asked to help with a major agency proposal that needed to be finished quickly. Jérémy was the ultimate team player and stayed with us working on the project until it was finally finished around 10 p.m. He handled every challenge that was given to him during that time and made sure everything was done the right way. Throughout his time at Moses, Jérémy always had a great attitude and handled every assignment with a smile on his face and a willingness to learn and do whatever it took to be successful. If you’re looking for a quality addition to your team, I highly recommend Jérémy Chevallier.”
